scope: source-only diagnostic; not outer eight-fold recognition evidence
hypothesis: Ordered range-distribution moments retain class information beyond static position; preserving absolute range may matter
split: outer fold1 source pool only; inner leave-one-source-user-out: five fit, one diagnostic evaluation
features: per-frame abs(raw RF) normalized across 189 bins; centroid and range standard deviation in bin coordinates; time mean-pool six frames to 15 blocks
static: temporal mean of centroid and spread, repeated 15 times; 90 dimensions, same distance geometry as six unique coordinates after scaling
ordered_relative: subtract each clip's temporal mean centroid, retain spread
sorted_marginals: independently sort each view/feature's 15 temporal blocks; same values, removes temporal order and cross-view time alignment
classifier: StandardScaler fit only on five inner training users; sklearn SVC RBF C=10 gamma=1/90 class_weight=balanced; no search or probability calibration
continue_gate: ordered_absolute mean macro accuracy >=0.85, exceeds static by >=0.05 with >=4/6 wins, exceeds sorted_marginals by >=0.01 with >=4/6 wins
if_pass: Only motivates an independent end-to-end temporal-moment hypothesis with matched controls; not innovation or full protocol success
if_fail: Stop this moment-sequence configuration; no hyperparameter grid or neural branch launch justified by this probe
limits: No measured hand position or velocity
Inner scores not comparable to historical outer eight-fold mean
Sorting changes feature distribution; not a causal temporal-order ablation
